verdict.rationale: Paperspace offers persistent storage, shared drives across machines, and API/CLI access (paperspace-docs-4, paperspace-docs-6, paperspace-probe-4) plus a marketing claim of 'free unlimited bandwidth' (paperspace-docs-20), but there's no documented S3-compatible endpoint or cloud-storage sync tool, and a hands-on report explicitly contradicts efficient transfer: 'Very slow internet, takes forever to copy datasets' via SSH access that's described as an uphill battle (paperspace-comm-7). Missing for 10: S3-compatible API/endpoint, dedicated sync/transfer CLI (e.g., rsync/rclone integration), and independent confirmation of transfer speed matching the bandwidth claims.
